data.body: **P2:** This root is only materialized from `onInvocationEnd`, after `Invocation` and `Workflow` were started against the synthetic placeholder context. With a deferred `RECORD_ONLY` decision, that placeholder remains sampled while the actual root is unsampled; custom updated trace state likewise exists only on the actual root. Descendants therefore report parent metadata that disagrees with the span whose ID they reference. Materialize the root during `onInvocationStart`, use `root.getSpanContext()` as `executionAncestor`, and retain/end it at invocation end. Add assertions for descendant parent flags and trace state under deferred/custom samplers.
